newsitem.title: USA: CAI Wireless says lawsuit without merit.
newsitem.headline: CAI Wireless says lawsuit without merit.

text.p: CAI Wireless Systems Inc said a class action lawsuit filed in U.S. District Court for the Northern District of New York on November 22 is without merit.

CAI has not yet been served with the complaint, but does not believe that the allegations summarized in a November 22 press release from the plaintiffs' law firm can be sustained or will result in any liability to the company, it said.

The lawsuit alleges that the company promoted its wireless cable television systems, but failed to disclose technical and regulatory problems associated with selling the products successfully, lawyers for the plaintiffs said.
CAI expects that it will be served with the lawsuit Monday and plans to vigorously defend the action.
"CAI has always taken a very conservative approach to its disclosure obligations, and we are confident that the facts will bear this out," said Jared Abbruzzese, CAI's chairman.

"As CAI has repeatedly expressed in its Securities and Exchange Commission filings and otherwise, this is an emerging technology, subject to various regulatory and other constraints, all of which CAI has worked within since its inception," Abbruzzese said.
